newsitem.title: USA: Safeway to open 35 new stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Safeway to open 35 new stores in 1997.

text.p: Safeway Inc said on Tuesday it plans to invest about $700 million in capital expenditures and open 35 new stores in 1997. It also said it plans to remodel 150 stores.

The company said in a statement that during the first three quarters of 1996, it invested $324 million in capital expenditures and opened 11 new stores. It expects to invest over $600 million for capital expenditures in 1996 and to open 30 to 35 new stores and complete more than 125 remodels.
Earlier, Safeway reported net income of $105.9 million or $0.44 a share for the third quarter of 1996, compared to $83.7 million or $0.35 a share in the year ago period.
